evidence: Wikipedia's article on Timbaland: he produced Jay-Z's 'Big Pimpin'' (1999).

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Listen for the flute line that loops through 'Big Pimpin'', taken from an Egyptian song, over Timbaland's bouncing, syncopated drums. A Virginia producer known for strange R&B rhythms is now behind one of the biggest New York rap records of the year.

explanation.age13: Timbaland, Missy Elliott's producer, made the beat for Jay-Z's 1999 hit 'Big Pimpin''.
explanation.adult: Timbaland's sound moving from R&B and Missy into New York rap. The Egyptian source of the flute line later led to a long copyright case, which is outside this map for now.
